title: Lakehouse, part 1: object store, Iceberg and zero-copy Bronze
goal: Stand up an open-source lakehouse and turn raw Parquet files in an S3 bucket into an Iceberg table without copying a byte.
parts: Run the stack in Codespaces or on your MacBook
Land 7 days of raw ride data with realistic dirt
Register the files in place with add_files
Protect Bronze so no engine can delete files it does not own
ms: make up-all, then open Jupyter (:8888) and Trino (:8080)
make land, then make bronze; read jobs/bronze_zero_copy.py
refs: Apache Iceberg docs: Spark procedures (add_files, migrate, snapshot)

title: Lakehouse, part 2: Silver, Gold with dbt, Airflow, ClickHouse
goal: Finish the medallion lakehouse: idempotent Silver with MERGE, Gold metrics, ML features and LLM context with dbt, a daily Airflow DAG, and ClickHouse serving the same tables.
parts: Gold: daily metrics, driver features, LLM-ready text
Daily DAG that can rerun any day safely
Iceberg internals notebook: snapshots, time travel, evolution, compaction
ms: make silver (twice: second run changes 0 rows), then make silver-spark
run lakehouse_daily in Airflow or make pipeline DAY=2026-10-08

title: Spark under load on your lakehouse
goal: Make the Silver job 10x bigger, then find and fix skew, small files and spills using the Spark UI.
parts: Generate a skewed day (one hot city)

title: Natural-language data assistant over the warehouse
goal: A chatbot that answers business questions in plain English by writing validated SQL against Gold.
stack: Free LLM: Ollama (local) or Gemini free tier
parts: SQL generation with a validator (sqlglot) and a read-only role
Eval set of 30 questions with expected answers
Refuse questions the data cannot answer
refs: AI Data Engineering Project for Beginners (nataindata)

title: Real-time AI streaming pipeline
goal: Stream ride events through Kafka, compute windowed features continuously and flag anomalies within seconds.
parts: Tumbling and sliding windows with watermarks
Exactly-once sink to ClickHouse and Iceberg
Anomaly alerts to a Slack webhook

title: CDC from Postgres into the lakehouse
goal: Capture every insert, update and delete from an operational database and apply it to Iceberg with MERGE.

title: AWS on your laptop: infrastructure as code and cost
goal: Rebuild the lakehouse ingestion with AWS-style services, defined in Terraform, running on LocalStack, with a cost estimate.
parts: IAM least privilege for each job
Monthly cost estimate for real AWS

title: Production RAG pipeline with metadata filtering
goal: Ingest support tickets and runbooks, chunk and embed them at scale, and answer questions with citations and filters.
parts: Embeddings with metadata tags (team, date, product)

title: LLM output evaluation and observability dashboard
goal: Log, score and monitor LLM responses for drift, latency, cost and hallucination.

title: Governed lakehouse and serving at scale
goal: Add catalog governance, lineage and a fast serving layer to the lakehouse.
parts: Column lineage across dbt and Spark

title: One-day customer build (forward-deployed engineering)
goal: Take a messy customer request, scope it in an hour, build a working slice in a day, and present it.
parts: Discovery questions and a one-page scope

title: Capstone: AI-ready data platform
goal: Combine lakehouse, streaming, RAG and the assistant into one platform and defend it in an architecture review.
